label: Website
note: Marketing and landing pages. Display type does the selling; grounds provide atmosphere. Previewed as a hero + nav + feature row.

label: App
note: Mobile screens in a phone frame. The UI font matters as much as the display; grounds stay quieter and radii friendlier.

label: Software tool
note: Dashboards, dev tools, admin panels. Density and legibility first — previewed as sidebar + stats + a live table.

label: Editorial
note: Articles and long reads. Measure, leading and reading comfort first — the ground is paper, not a stage.

label: Docs
note: Documentation. Body and code coexist; callouts and borders do the structural work.
